OneRep can save the strength sessions you finish here to Apple Health, so your training shows up alongside the rest of your activity.

OneRep reads Apple Health workouts, distance, heart rate, and routes to import cardio details, plus sleep, steps, resting heart rate, and heart rate variability so your coach can tell a hard week from an under-recovered one.

OneRep reads completed cardio workouts, heart rate, distance, and active energy so your training history is complete. With your permission it can also write finished OneRep sessions back to Health Connect.
OneRep reads device tilt so the hero artwork can drift as you move your phone.
OneRep reads the photo you pick so it can log the meal or read the barcode in it.

OneRep uses speech recognition to turn your Coach dictation into text.
